$description: Aspect-ratio scale (library plan wave 1, foundation aspect-ratio-scale): the width-to-height ratios a media frame, preview or card may take, as CSS ratios. system/ratio.css draws them as the .plx-ratio-<w>-<h> classes.

ratio-1-1.$description: Aspect ratio 1:1, a square: avatars, icon tiles and square thumbnails in a grid.

ratio-4-3.$description: Aspect ratio 4:3, landscape: the default media frame of an asset card and a preview.

ratio-3-2.$description: Aspect ratio 3:2, landscape: photographs as most cameras take them.

ratio-16-9.$description: Aspect ratio 16:9, wide: video, screenshots and banners.

ratio-21-9.$description: Aspect ratio 21:9, very wide: page heroes and cinematic video.

ratio-3-4.$description: Aspect ratio 3:4, portrait: documents, book covers and portrait photographs.

ratio-9-16.$description: Aspect ratio 9:16, tall: phone screens, stories and vertical video.
